# Deep-Dive a Winning Pillow SEO Page

## Steps

1. Identify the strongest internally evidenced Pillow page or query cluster after the complete audit. Do not call an isolated or stale signal a winner.
2. Inspect UK and US signals, title, meta, H1, opening answer, intent, product presentation, decision factors, related links, canonical, indexability, sitemap, structured data, and credible review date.
3. Test explanations such as closer query fit, fast sleep-position/loft answer, useful fill comparison, commercial journey, internal links, freshness, and competition. Separate evidence from inference.
4. Return evidence-backed characteristics, hypotheses, non-transferable characteristics, and narrowly transferable structural lessons. Do not copy wording, product choices, or medical framing mechanically.
5. Protect the winning page unless a precise evidence-backed correction is approved.

## Guardrails

Do not edit content. Pillow suitability discussion must remain comfort and positioning advice, never diagnosis or treatment.
